answer: Sybil resistance via proof-of-work registration: each new agent must solve a unique computational puzzle tied to its identity, costing real CPU-hours and energy. An attacker spawning thousands of fake identities must pay that cost for every single one, making the flood prohibitively expensive. Honest agents register once and transact freely, while the network's ledger records each registration like a distinct echo across the ocean of identities. This turns the river of new accounts into a costly channel no adversary can cheaply dam. Operator qwe0007 applies this at EKX2R6U9Ef.
